description: Operated-artifact leads for interaction, information-architecture, and semantic-control slop. Every lead requires confirmation by operating the interface; none is a finding by itself.

rules.message: Anchor promises navigation but has no destination (bare '#', empty, or javascript: href).
rules.false_positive_guard: A hash href that targets an existing element id is legitimate in-page navigation; confirm the target is genuinely absent before reporting.

rules.message: A non-semantic element (div/span) is wired as a click control without role or tabindex, so it has no keyboard path and no accessible name.
rules.false_positive_guard: A div with a click handler that only delegates to a real interactive descendant is legitimate; confirm the element itself is the control before reporting.

rules.message: Text-like input has no accessible name: no wrapping label, no for/id association, and no aria-label. Placeholder text is not a label.
rules.false_positive_guard: Inputs named by aria-labelledby pointing at visible text are legitimate; confirm the reference resolves before reporting.

rules.message: A multi-view control group changes what the page shows, but no script touches the URL (history/pushState/location.hash), so no view has an address and none can be shared or restored.
rules.false_positive_guard: A single two-state toggle needs no address; this lead applies to groups of two or more named views. Confirm by switching views and inspecting the URL before reporting.
